content:
sara: starting a green-run canary for qllama-13b-int8 -> qllama-13b-fp16 fallback policy. routing 3% traffic to int8 variant now. will watch perf + quality signals for 1h.

jia: noted. saved eval set as canary_eval_v3. focusing on customers: summarization & code-gen slices.

mike: quick heads-up — autoscaling limits for int8 pods are lower; if latency spikes we'll see 429s at 95th. set a soft circuit at 0.8% 429 rate.

sara: thanks. added soft-circuit: if 429_rate > 0.8% or p95_latency > 650ms for >5m -> auto-fallback to fp16. also setting quality trigger: delta_pass_rate <= -2.5% on canary_eval_v3 -> rollback.

noah: initial numbers after 10m: token_cost delta = -21%, avg_latency +40ms, p95 +70ms, pass_rate change = -0.9% (summaries), -2.8% (code-gen). code-gen slice crosses the quality trigger.

mike: hmm. is the -2.8% on the heavy prompt subset or overall? we should avoid noisy single-prompt regressions.

jia: it's concentrated on code-gen longer-context prompts >512 tokens. I dug into top 5 failing prompts, pattern looks like missing subtle whitespace/formatting tokens after quantization.

sara: good catch. for now increase routing to 1% for int8 on non-code-gen routes, and set AB split by route. revert code-gen traffic to baseline.

mike: can we patch quant config (per-channel vs per-tensor) quickly? or run a targeted micro-canary for code-gen with different quant profile?

sara: planning micro-canary: 0.5% traffic for code-gen with int8-per-channel variant. if pass_rate delta <= -1% -> keep, else fallback. starting that now.

deploy-bot: [deployment] green-run canary qllama-13b-int8-per-channel started at 1842003599, routing: code-gen 0.5%, other routes 1%.

noah: 15m update from micro-canary: code-gen pass_rate delta -0.3% (within noise), p95 620ms -> under latency circuit. cost delta still -18% for that slice. looks promising.

sara: great. plan: promote int8-per-channel for non-code routes to 10% tonight, keep code-gen on micro-canary for another hour then expand to 3% if stable. set automatic fallback thresholds: any 30m window where (pass_rate_delta <= -2%) OR (p95_latency increase >=200ms) OR (error_rate >=1%) -> immediate rollback to fp16 variant and alert on-call.

mike: add metric to compare generation entropy/stability (we saw token-level repetition change earlier). if entropy_delta < -0.15 -> flag as quality regression.

sara: added entropy check. deploying metric hooks. thanks everyone.

jia: saving notes and config to the canary run doc: /runbooks/quant-canary-v3 (internal). will post a short summary in #eng-ml after 1h. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [alert-rule] automatic rollback gates created: latency/p95, pass_rate, error_rate, entropy. thresholds: latency 200ms, pass_rate -2%, error_rate 1%, entropy -0.15.

noah: tl;dr — int8-per-channel looks usable for most routes, code-gen needs cautious rollout. fallback gates seem conservative enough to avoid user impact.

sara: closing the loop: keep active monitoring, we'll snapshot the top failing prompts before any auto-fallback triggers so we can triage quickly. thanks all.
